description:
This strapless ball gown is crafted from silk satin and defined by a structured bodice with a sweetheart neckline that flows into a voluminous skirt with graceful presence. The silhouette is elevated by an intricate composition of hand-sewn beads, sequins, drills, crystals, pearls, and stones, creating a richly embellished surface with remarkable depth and luminosity.    
   
  Handcrafted by a team of seven to ten skilled couturiers over 600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision of execution, exceptional craftsmanship, and meticulous attention to detail.

With its mesmerizing seashell-inspired embellishment and striking off-the-shoulder silhouette, this long-sleeved gown aptly showcases the artistry and boundless creativity of couture. Luminous crepe forms a soft curve at the neckline before draping fluidly to the floor. The gown is adorned with an iridescent composition of hand-sewn beads, sequins, crystals, pearls, and stones, blending delicate shades of blush pink, aqua, opal, and ivory to evoke the luminous beauty of a seashell.  
   
   Handcrafted by a team of skilled couturiers over 300 hours, the gown embodies couture defined by exceptional craftsmanship, intricate surface artistry, and timeless elegance.

This strapless aquamarine ball gown is crafted from mikado silk and defined by a structured corseted bodice. The neckline follows a softly curved, wave-like line, delicately hand-embroidered with sequins and crystals along the upper edge. From the waist, the fabric opens into a full skirt with a clear, structured shape.  
     
  Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision of cut, material control, and balanced proportion.

This floor-length ball gown is crafted from liquid satin in a deep plum tone and defined by a structured bodice and a full skirt. The bodice features a shell-inspired construction, executed through precise internal shaping and hand embroidery of pearls and sequins arranged in controlled vertical flow. The satin surface holds its form through the upper body before opening into volume from the waist, creating a balanced architectural silhouette.  
   
  Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 550 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by material control, precision of cut, and disciplined structure.

This gown is crafted from soft tulle and defined by a structured mermaid silhouette shaped through dense hand embroidery. The neckline forms a shell-like contour, framed with clustered pearls that articulate the upper edge with sculptural clarity. Sequins, crystals, and beads are arranged in successive lines across the surface, generating controlled luminosity and visual rhythm. Along the sides, layered tulle cascades in formations inspired by the structure of fish scales, integrated seamlessly into the silhouette.  
   
  Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface mastery and structural precision.

This short gown is defined by a sculpted bodice formed as two opposing shell shapes, immersed in pearls, and a precisely engineered structure through the hips that shapes the silhouette and stabilizes the line. Internally reinforced for definition, the surface is composed of real mother-of-pearl fragments hand-assembled into a luminous mosaic that responds to light with controlled brilliance, interspersed with thousands of crystals, natural pearls, and beads.  
   
  The hem is finished with suspended pearl drops, while a sheer veil adorned with crystal droplets completes the look. Handcrafted by a team of seven skilled couturiers over 900 hours, the piece reflects couture defined by material integrity, structural control, and surface precision.

This gown features a full skirt constructed from multiple layers of tulle, organized into repeated tiers with scalloped shell-shaped edges. The bodice is formed through two opposing shell structures, densely hand-embroidered with sequins, beads, crystals, and pearls arranged in precise tonal gradations of lilac, amber, and soft neutral hues. The embroidery extends across each tier in a continuous, symmetrical rhythm, visually unifying the bodice and skirt into a single composition.  
   
  The layered construction introduces depth while preserving clarity of silhouette and controlled luminosity. The piece reflects couture defined by surface mastery and structural precision.

This gown is crafted from satin and defined by a sculpted, shell-inspired mermaid silhouette. The surface is fully hand-embroidered with sequins, beads, crystals, and pearls, arranged through a layered composition that begins with paired shell forms at the upper and lower body before unfolding into a precise radiating pattern. Tonal variations of lilac, amber, aquamarine, and sand-inflected hues are integrated within the embroidery, referencing shell surfaces and marine elements with controlled luminosity. The construction emphasizes clarity of form and disciplined surface balance.  
   
  Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,500 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by intensive handwork and structural precision.

This floor-length gown is crafted from soft tulle in a warm yellow tone, shaped through an elongated, fluid silhouette. An asymmetric neckline is formed by fine draped pleats that descend across the body, creating a continuous line of movement. Delicate hand embroidery of sequins, beads, and natural stones is applied in controlled placements, tracing the form without interrupting its flow. The skirt opens subtly toward the hem, allowing lightness and motion to define the finish.  
   
  Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 600 hours.

This ball gown is constructed from silk satin in warm, sunlit tones and defined by a sculpted strapless bodice. The neckline forms a shell-like contour, fully hand-embroidered with sequins, crystals, and beads arranged in precise tonal gradations of yellow, apricot, and soft brown. The embroidery builds a contoured surface that defines the upper body with clarity. Below, the satin skirt opens from the waist into a balanced volume, allowing the material’s natural sheen to articulate movement.  
   
  Handcrafted by a team of six skilled couturiers over 700 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface mastery and structural precision.

This floor-length, close-fitting gown is crafted from sheer tulle and chiffon in a soft blush pink tone, defined by an elongated silhouette that follows the body with lightness. The surface is hand-embroidered with sequins, crystals, and natural coral beads, arranged in a controlled gradation that reflects light across shell-like forms. The skirt is composed of layered sheer chiffon panels that fall into a mermaid silhouette, with overlapping side formations evoking the structure of fish scales.  
     
  Handcrafted by a team of nine skilled couturiers over 1,000 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision.

This strapless gown is crafted from soft satin and constructed through hundreds of hand-embroidered shell forms. Each shell is individually built with thousands of beads, sequins, crystals, and pearls arranged in precise tonal gradations across the surface. The embroidery is shaped to create a contoured relief with subtle raised ridges that echo the natural structure of real shells. An irregular scalloped neckline and hemline follow the outline of the shell forms، reinforcing the sculptural construction.  
   
  Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by extreme handwork and precision.

This floor-length gown is executed in a deep wine-toned crepe base, shaped into a close, controlled silhouette. The neckline is sculpted into a shell-inspired form, delicately hand-embroidered with pearls and sequins that define the upper structure with quiet precision. Around the hip, liquid satin is wrapped in measured drapery, before extending seamlessly into a long, flowing tail that reinforces the sense of movement and balance.  
     
  Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 450 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by clarity of form, material control, and restrained elegance.

This floor-length gown is built on a close, sculpted crepe silhouette that traces the body with restraint. Over the bodice, lustrous taffeta is shaped into fluid drapery forming shell-like contours. The taffeta continues seamlessly from the front toward the back, then descends to the floor as a single extended tail. Its scalloped edges follow an irregular outline, recalling the layered structure of fish scales while remaining refined and controlled.  
   
  Handcrafted by a team of skilled couturiers, the gown reflects couture defined by material continuity and balance.

This floor-length gown is executed in deep wine-toned tulle and defined by a fluid silhouette with a halter construction. Sheer panels drape from the shoulders, framing the body with controlled movement. The surface is hand-embroidered with sequins, beads, and crystals arranged into marine motifs, including corals, shells, and starfish. Subtle accents of mauve, blue, and rose emerge through the embroidery, creating depth against the dark base.  
   
  Handcrafted by a team of nine skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface precision and layered execution.

This floor-length gown is crafted from soft tulle, shaped through precise laser cutting to define the silhouette with clarity. The design follows the body in a structured line before widening at the hem into a balanced mermaid form. Layered tulle panels introduce visible depth and surface texture while maintaining controlled, fluid movement. A pronounced vertical construction runs through the piece, establishing a refined balance between structure and lightness.  
   
  Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 550 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by technical precision and material control.

This couture ensemble is composed of a structured crepe top and a fluid crepe skirt in an butter yellow tone. The upper piece is defined by a corseted construction and a fully hand-embroidered surface of beads, sequins, and crystals arranged in soft aqua gradations.  
   
  The skirt extends in mermaid cut. A sheer aqua tulle veil, executed as a separate element, drapes over the arms and head. Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 550 hours, the ensemble reflects couture defined by precision and restraint.

This floor-length couture look is composed of a structured corset and a fluid crepe skirt. The corset is shaped with fine pleating in a   soft aqua tone  , forming a shell-like structure executed in tulle and reinforced through hand embroidery. Sequins, beads, and crystals are applied in controlled gradations of turquoise and lilac, creating a concentrated surface sheen along the bodice.  
   
  The crepe skirt is constructed from elongated ivory panels that open vertically, handcrafted by a team of six skilled couturiers over 650 hours, the piece reflects couture defined by precision, surface control, and sculptural balance.

This floor-length   ball gown   is constructed from layered fine tulle, creating structured volume through lightness. The bodice forms a shell-shaped motif, executed with dense hand embroidery of crystals, sequins, beads, and pearls arranged in precise radiating lines that extend downward across the skirt. Soft tonal transitions of ivory, pink, and pale blue enhance depth within the embroidery.  
   
  A separately embroidered bolero frames the shoulders, echoing the same embroidery language. Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision.

This floor-length gown is crafted from crepe in a soft blush pink tone, defined by a fluid silhouette layered with soft tulle. The design unfolds in tiered levels, each edged with delicate hand embroidery arranged in subtle gradations of purple and blue. The embellishment remains concentrated along the hems, creating a shifting shimmer that moves in soft, wave-like rhythms with each step, allowing the layered tulle to move freely.  
   
  Handcrafted by a team of six skilled couturiers over   600 hours  , the gown reflects couture defined by lightness, precision, and controlled motion.

This couture look is composed of a floor-length crepe skirt and a delicately hand-embroidered cropped top. The top is worked with crystals, sequins, beads, and pearls arranged in natural shell-inspired gradations, forming a luminous surface that defines the upper body with clarity. The skirt falls in a clean, elongated line, maintaining structure through restraint.  
  The look is completed by a sculptural three-dimensional shell element, crafted from liquid taffeta and embroidered with natural pearls. Attached to the body, it wraps around the arm and extends to the floor as an integral structural component of the design.     
   Handcrafted by a team of seven skilled couturiers over 700 hours, the piece reflects couture defined by surface mastery and sculptural construction.

This floor-length halter gown is crafted from lightweight aquamarine crepe. Sophisticated hand embroidery of sequins and beads is arranged in radiating lines from the neckline and waist, establishing a clear visual rhythm across the body. From the waist, elongated handmade beaded fringe extends over the skirt, creating a luminous, continuous movement that becomes more pronounced with each step.  
   
  Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface precision, controlled motion, and material discipline.

The neckline follows a softly curved, wave-like line, delicately hand-embroidered with sequins and crystals along the upper edge. From the waist, the fabric opens into a full skirt with a clear, structured shape.  
     
  Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision of cut, material control, and balanced proportion.

This aquamarine gown is crafted from mikado silk and defined by a structured corseted bodice that shapes the silhouette with clarity. The neckline follows a shell-like curve, delicately hand-embroidered with pearls, sequins, and crystals along the upper edge. A draped twist at the hip introduces controlled movement, from which the fabric extends into a clean column skirt finished with a soft trailing train. 
 Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 500 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision of cut, material control, and balanced proportion.

This floor-length aquamarine gown is crafted from finely worked dentelle and defined by a fitted, elongated silhouette. The off-shoulder neckline opens the upper frame, while the long sleeves are integrated into the lace structure, extending the line of the body. The transparency of the dentelle allows the embroidery to remain visually present across the surface.  
   
  Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface precision, disciplined execution, and balanced proportion.

This floor-length gown is crafted from sheer ivory dentelle, featuring hand-embroidered detailing integrated into the surface. From the neckline, vertical strands of natural pearl fringes extend across the gown, introducing movement that becomes more pronounced with each step. The pearls interact with the transparency of the lace, creating a layered visual rhythm.  
   
  Handcrafted by a team of seven skilled couturiers over 900 hours, the gown reflects couture built on material expression, precision, and a considered approach to transparency.

title_ar: فستان أم اللؤلؤ الملكي – MOTHER PEARL GOWN
description:
This strapless, floor-length gown is defined by a straight column silhouette and a bodice constructed from hand-carved mother-of-pearl laminate. Each tile is cut, polished, and assembled to form a continuous, iridescent surface that reflects light through the natural properties of the material. The bodice establishes the visual identity and weight of the piece with clarity and precision.  
     
  From the waist, vertical strands of natural pearls and hand-set crystal droplets descend over chiffon, introducing controlled luminous movement in contrast to the structured upper form. Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by material mastery, precision, and permanence.

This strapless, floor-length gown is defined by a straight column silhouette and a fully hand-embroidered surface. The surface is entirely worked with hand-cut mother-of-pearl tiles, faceted crystals, and natural pearls, assembled into a dense, reflective field that captures and returns light with controlled intensity. The embroidery establishes the visual identity of the piece while maintaining a continuous vertical line.  
   A sheer tulle cape veil extends from the head and shoulders, introducing fluid movement in contrast to the structured silhouette. Handcrafted by a team of ten couturiers over 1,600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface mastery.

This floor-length gown is defined by a commanding, fully hand-embroidered surface that shapes the identity of the piece. The high-neck bodice is worked with hand-cut mother-of-pearl elements, faceted crystals, and natural pearls, assembled to form a dense, luminous surface that captures and reflects light with clarity. The embroidery establishes the visual weight of the gown while articulating the upper body through precision. 
   
 From the bodice, fluid chiffon panels extend downward, opening the silhouette into movement. Handcrafted by seven skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown embodies couture defined by surface mastery, material discipline, and enduring presence beyond season and trend.

A strapless burgundy gown with an elegant A-line silhouette, crafted from luxurious crepe fabric. Featuring a corset construction for structure and a velvet scarf for a regal touch, the gown is accented with intricate hand embroidery along the neckline. This design is the result of over 300 hours of meticulous craftsmanship by a team of ten expert couturiers, embodying the essence of timeless couture.

Roselle is a delicate blend of striking design, timeless elegance and couture flair. This halterneck gown is finely tailored from luminous satin in a svelte ankle-length cut finishing with a scalloped  hem. Extending from the waist is an elaborate gathered train, its delicate folds meticulously shaped and stitched by hand to mimic the soft curves of petals. This recurring floral motif, which is seen throughout the collection as a symbol of resilience and renewal, is replicated here in waves of glistening flower motifs, which adorn the lower skirt and train. Every element of this gown is  handcrafted by a team of talented couturiers, who devote over 300 hours to its creation.

A luminous creation designed in partnership with Zahra Breast Cancer Association, Lune radiates powerful femininity and  sophistication. The sylphlike silhouette is formed from lustrous ivory crepe, which is sculpted at the neckline with two exquisite lotuses. The sensitivity and beauty of the design not only testifies to the craftsmanship and vision of Waad Aloqaili, but serves as a fitting tribute to women throughout the world living with breast cancer.

Emeralds is a striking mermaid gown that exudes sophistication and modern femininity. Crafted from flowing emerald-green crepe, the dress is expertly tailored to trace the body’s silhouette, cascading into a dramatic floor-length skirt. A glistening dragonfly, formed from a myriad of beads, sequins and crystals, rests delicately on the gown, symbolizing transformation and renewal. Every intricate detail testifies to the dedication of Waad Aloqaili couturiers who invest 350 hours to bring this masterpiece to life.

A luminous creation designed in partnership with Zahra Breast Cancer Association, Lune radiates powerful femininity and  sophistication. The sylphlike silhouette is formed from lustrous ivory crepe, which is sculpted at the neckline with two exquisite lotuses. The sensitivity and beauty of the design not only testifies to the craftsmanship and vision of Waad Aloqaili, but serves as a fitting tribute to women throughout the world living with breast cancer.

title_ar: فستان كوتور – Garden of delight GOWN
description: Created in partnership with Zahra Breast Cancer Association,Garden of Delight emanates timeless elegance and feminine strength. Luminous silks and tulle are expertly tailored to form a billowing skirt and strapless bodice, shaped at the neckline with two lotus flowers that symbolize renewal and purity. Lustrous threads, gemstones, sequins, and beads enrich the floral design, catching the light with every movement. A team of artisans dedicate over 400 hours to perfect the gown’s ageless ballgown silhouette and exquisite adornment.

With streams of lustrous adornment and a slender silhouette, Moonlit is the epitome of timeless elegance. Thousands of hand-sewn sequins, beads and gems mimic the shimmering wings of the magnificent dragonfly—a powerful symbol of transformation and rebirth. Gossamer layers of georgette and tulle are skillfully hand-shaped to form a demure high neck, sensual mermaid skirt and billowing, wing-like cape. A team of consummate artisans craft every element of the design over the course of 800 hours.

Flooded with glistening beads, sequins and crystals, Golden Dew is an ode to the artistry of couture. Meticulously tailored to the contours of the body, the gown falls to the floor with a classic mermaid skirt and features elegant gloved sleeves. Drawing on powerful symbolism of the enigmatic dragonfly, the dress features a wing shaped cut-out at the waist, which extends to form a dramatic plunge neckline. Additional cut-outs at the back mirror this evocative motif. Skillful couturiers finesse every stitch, fold and cut over the course of 800 hours to ensure an impeccable finish.

Capturing an air of quiet dynamism and timeless grace, Glide is the culmination of over 700 hours of couture craftsmanship and masterful design. Echoing the brilliance of the dragonfly, reams of jewel-green crepe are expertly tailored by a team of artisans to form a fitted bodice and spliced mermaid skirt. Two straps, that tumble from the shoulder, feature elegant wing motifs composed of a myriad of beads, sequins and crystals.

Orchid is a luminous full-length gown that combines opulence with exemplary craftsmanship. Lustrous satin, chiffon and tulle are carefully manipulated by hand to form delicate, undulating folds that gently embrace the figure and stream to the floor, evoking the organic, sinuous form of flowers. Beads, sequins and crystals, each one meticulously sewn by hand adorn each fine pleat, creating a perpetual shimmer. A team of ten talented couturiers spend a total of 300 hours handcrafting every contour and artistic element of this captivating creation.

This sublime couture gown exudes sophistication. Reams of black crepe, draped to perfection by skilled dressmakers, follow the natural curves of the body and finish in a dramatic mermaid train. Wing-shaped shoulder cut-outs and bejeweled gloved sleeves allude to the rarely seen wings of a dragonfly-an evocative motif that weaves throughout the collection, symbolizing rebirth and transformation. An exemplary team of ten talented couturiers pour their expertise, talent and passion into creating this exceptional design over the course of 300 hours.

Noir is a remarkable full-length gown that blends faultless craftsmanship with understated elegance. The alluring off-the-shoulder neckline and exaggerated mermaid skirt are meticulously tailored from reams of black crepe, and adorned with dozens of shimmering beads, sequins and gemstones. Ostrich feathers trace the line of each sleeve-an allusion to the dragonfly as a metaphor for self-transformation. Ten talented dressmakers and artisans spend over 300 hours perfecting this magnificent creation.
Exclusive Haute Couture gown from Waad Aloqaili, handcrafted with the finest fabrics and intricate hand embroidery.

This divine long sleeve gown is a masterpiece of modern couture design and craftsmanship. Formed by hand from swathes of lilac georgette and soft tulle, Lila features a demure high neckline and softly gathered skirt that cascades to the floor. An exquisite lattice, composed of scores of hand-placed beads, sequins, and crystals, envelops the surface of the gown, mimicking the dragonfly’s iridescent wings. This radiant creation is the culmination of over 700 hours of exemplary hand-tailoring and finishing by a team of accomplished dressmakers.

Allure is a luminous creation inspired by the remarkable lotus flower-an enduring symbol of resilience and renewal. The timeless silhouette is composed of delicate layers of crepe, georgette and tulle, overlaid with an exquisite floral design. Glistening petals of rose pink and cornflower blue cover the gown; every bead, sequin, crystal and gemstone meticulously hand-stitched in place. From the first cut of fabric to the last stitch, every element of the gown is considered and precise; a team of ten dedicate around 900 hours to its creation.

Dragonflies is a mesmerizing blend of opulence, elegance and artisanship. Soft satin is perfectly contoured to follow the natural curves of the body, creating a sensuously smooth silhouette. Ripples of beads, sequins and crystals in azure blue and teal cover every inch of the gown, mimicking the sinuous form of dragonfly wings. From the elaborate full-length embellishment to the figure-defining silhouette, every element of this gown is masterfully executed by skilled couturiers over the course of 900 hours.

Named after the delicate spring flower, Primrose is equally demure and spectacular. Lengths of hazy pink taffeta, meticulously sculpted by accomplished dressmakers, form an enchanting strapless ballgown silhouette. The waistline is defined by elegant folds, which replicate the sinuous form of petals, a motif that reappears as undulations in the softly gathered skirt. A team of talented dressmakers, each one wholly devoted to the craft and artistry of couture, spend hundreds of hours creating this unforgettable gown.

Celeste is an enchanting halterneck gown that blends exemplary artisanship with modern femininity. Diaphanous chiffon, delicately pleated by hand, mirrors the form of dragonfly wings-an allusion to quiet strength-as hand-applied threads, gemstones, and beads sweep down the sides of the body, catching the light with every movement. A team of artisans invest over 300 hours to bring this timeless and exceptional couture masterpiece to life

This enchanting blush-pink gown pays homage to the beauty and quiet strength of the lotus flower. Lengths of diaphanous crepe and tulle greet the floor, enshrouded by a billowing cape that dances with the air with every subtle movement. Ten talented couturiers spend around 300 hours perfecting the smooth figure-defining cut and meticulous application of hundreds of glistening beads, sequins and crystals.

Capturing an air of serenity, Symphony is the embodiment of modern elegance and couture artistry. Whisper-thin layers of chiffon and soft tulle are shaped by hand into an asymmetric silhouette and finely gathered skirt that pools around the feet. An intricate formation of glimmering beads, crystals and sequins stretch across the figure, mirroring the elegant curve and iridescence of dragonfly wings. This enchanting couture creation is formed over the course of 300 hours by a team of dedicated dressmakers and artisans.

Inspired by the purity and strength of the lotus flower, this breathtaking creation demonstrates the beauty of simplicity. Draped to perfection in a timeless ballgown silhouette,   Opal   fits seamlessly on the body with a form-fitting bodice that blossoms into an elegant full skirt. Pristine ivory taffeta, hand-sculpted by a dedicated team of couturiers, adorn the hip-line in perfect symmetry. A team of skilled dressmakers pour hundreds of hours of meticulous craftsmanship into the creation of this unforgettable gown.

With its mesmerizing embellishment and striking off-the-shoulder silhouette, this long-sleeved gown aptly showcases the artistry and boundless creativity of couture. Luminous crepe, shaped by hand, forms a soft curve at the neckline before draping fluidly in a mermaid silhouette to the floor. The gown is adorned with a plethora of shimmering beads and crystals, each one meticulously hand-sewn to form a striking lotus motif, which wraps around the upper bodice. A team of dedicated couturiers invest 300 hours to bring this exquisite creation to life.

This enchanting strapless gown captures the quiet strength of the dragonfly and lotus flower, with an elaborate floral design formed from thousands of hand-stitched beads and sequins. The mesmerizing floral motif ripples out from the waistline in a symphony of color that transitions from barely-there peach to pink and azure blue. Artfully and expertly created by a team of dressmakers over the course of 600 hours, this satin gown is the pinnacle of couture craftsmanship and design excellence.
